<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <SLayout name="app">
    <SAppBar for="app" density="compact" position="sticky">
      <SButton size="small" color="primary" @click="open = true">Open</SButton>
    </SAppBar>
    <SDialog v-model="open">
      <template #activator="{ on, attrs }">
        <s-button v-bind="attrs" :block="true" v-on="on">Details</s-button>
      </template>
      <SForm>
        <SInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" :rules="[]" />
      </SForm>
    </SDialog>
  </SLayout>
</template>
